New album

Becomes part of the link: /<album-id>#<secret>. Letters, digits, . _ -.
At least 16 characters (a-z A-Z 0-9 _ -). The secret also signs every photo URL, so a short one can be brute-forced from a single leaked link.
← Albums

Share

One link per secret. Open the link or download the QR code.

Photos

Drop files here or choose them. Any image format; converted in the browser to JPEG 3000px + 1000px preview. Photos already uploaded anywhere are attached without re-uploading.
Add photos from another album
Photos are stored once and shared between albums; this only adds references, nothing is copied.

Settings

To rotate: add a new one, share the new link, then remove the old.
Instant, nothing is copied. Old links stop working immediately.

Delete album

The album goes to Trash and can be restored. Photos stay in shared storage; run GC orphans to reclaim space.
← Albums

Trash

Deleting an album keeps its info.json here. Restore puts it back (optionally under a new ID). Photos referenced only by a trashed album are still collected by GC orphans.
